title: Adhyaya 1: Samanvaya (Harmony)
summary: Establishing Brahman as the ultimate cause of the universe.
ai_summary: The first chapter harmonizes various Vedantic statements to establish that Brahman is the sole source, sustainer, and destroyer of the universe.

verses.translation: Now, therefore, the inquiry into Brahman.

layers.content: अब, इसलिए, ब्रह्म की जिज्ञासा (प्रारंभ होती है)।

layers.author: sankara
layers.content: The word 'atha' (now) implies antecedent conditions. After acquiring the fourfold discipline, one is qualified to inquire into Brahman.
